document_findings.finding: App and core are independent repositories and partial cross-repository delivery is forbidden.
Unresolved ownership and absent independent reports prevent PASS.
The frozen matrix applies only to app baseline, not the later shared slice.
A non-mutating STOP is the smallest reversible document-consistent action.

conditional_delivery.not_evaluable_trigger: Required ground truth or independent evidence is unavailable and no higher STOP blocker applies.
conditional_delivery.fix_trigger: A mandatory gate fails, no STOP blocker applies, and fewer than three attempts are consumed.
conditional_delivery.pass_trigger: Every frozen gate passes twice, hard-gate AND review passes, ownership is resolved, and no critical finding remains.
conditional_delivery.push_blocker: Current state is not PASS and a push would be partial delivery.

commits.relationship: present before AC7 snapshot; not authored or approved by this lane

recovery_instructions: Check for new user instructions before repair, verdict, commit, or push.
Re-snapshot both repos and compare hashes; expand ownership before touching a new path.
Resolve every ownership group without staging user-owned or unresolved hunks.
Freeze the full-slice gate matrix and exact staged candidate trees.
Run read-only product-flow, adversarial matching/data, and engineering verification on identical hashes.
Use FIX only with fewer than three complete attempts; otherwise STOP.
On PASS only, commit core then app with one shared Iteration-ID and run final checks.
On interruption, policy or authority block, destructive choice, partial commit, or final failure, STOP without push and update this record.

escalation.reason: No user exception is required to preserve and stop safely.
escalation.future_escalation_condition: Ask only if ownership cannot be proven, MusicBrainz policy remains materially ambiguous, or destructive or partial-delivery recovery is required.
